content: दिव्य {%a.%} [दिवि भवः यत्] .²1 Divine, heavenly, celestial; दिव्यस्त्वं हि न मानुषः <ls>Mb. 3. 252. 8</ls>. .²2 Supernatural, wonderful; परदोषेक्षणदिव्यचक्षुषः <ls>Śi. 16. 29</ls>; दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः <ls>Bg. 11. 8</ls>. .²3 Brilliant, splendid. .²4 Charming, beautiful. .{@-व्यः@} .²1 A superhuman or celestial being; दिव्यानामपि कृतविस्मयां पुरस्तात् <ls>Śi. 8. 64</ls>. .²2 Barley. .²3 An epithet of Yama. .²4 A fragrant resin, bdellium. .²5 A philosopher. .{@-व्यम्@} .²1 Celestial nature, divinity. .²2 The sky. .²3 An ordeal (of which 10 kinds are enumerated); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Y. 2. 22</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">95</ls>. .²4 An oath, a solemn declaration. .²5 Cloves. .²6 A kind of sandal. .²7 A kind of water.
